subject: Music Production
title: Skrillex and the Bass Drop
description: A quick win: understand Skrillex and the Bass Drop.

hook.text: Sonny Moore left his rock band to produce aggressive electronic music as Skrillex.

buildup.text: His tracks featured extreme bass drops, glitchy wobbles, and distorted synths at punishing volume.

discovery.text: The dubstep sound split audiences: fans loved the energy while critics called it noise.

twist.text: Skrillex won three Grammy Awards in one night, silencing doubters of electronic dance production.

climax.text: His success brought electronic production from underground clubs into the mainstream industry.

punchline.text: Aggressive noise won Grammys and changed the game.

quiz.question: What genre did Skrillex help bring into the mainstream?
